about.title: About MADAD
about.lead: MADAD tells you where a pharmacy recently reported a medicine available, and when. This is a prototype with demo data.

sections.title: What MADAD does
sections.body: MADAD collects availability reports that pharmacies enter themselves and shows each one with its time. A report that is too old shows as “Unconfirmed”, never as available.

sections.title: What it does not do
sections.body: MADAD does not sell, deliver or reserve medicines, and gives no medical advice, alternatives or doses. Dispensing happens at the pharmacy, at the pharmacist's judgement.

sections.title: Contact us
sections.body: This is a demo version. The official contact channel will be announced at launch.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: We collect as little data as possible.

sections.title: Searching without an account
sections.body: You can search and browse pharmacies without an account. The search log is fully anonymous: the search text, governorate and result count only.

sections.title: Location
sections.body: We ask for your location only when you tap “Nearest” or “Use my location”. It is used in your browser to compute distance and is never sent to us.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: An account needs only a name and email; mobile is optional. There are no medical fields. You can download your data or delete your account from your account page.

sections.title: Inquiries
sections.body: Organizations see your inquiries with your display name only. Do not write personal medical information in them.

terms.title: Terms
terms.lead: By using MADAD you agree to the following.

sections.title: Nature of the information
sections.body: Availability comes from pharmacies and is shown as reported, with its time. It may not be accurate when you visit, so call to confirm.

sections.title: No medical advice
sections.body: The site gives no diagnosis or medicine recommendation. Ask your doctor or pharmacist.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Entering misleading information or misusing reports and inquiries is not allowed.
